name: Marbles Teen Play Corps
what_you_do: Play with young kids at a children's museum. You help in the exhibits, programs, camps and events, and give at least 30 service hours a year.
who_can_apply: Rising 7th graders and older who are at least 12 years old by the first in-person training. The page lists no residency rule.
duration: One year. Minimum 30 service hours a year to stay active.
deadline_text: Apply December 1, 2026 to January 31, 2027 (5 PM). You must first attend an information session with a parent or guardian: Nov 14, Dec 10, 2026, or Jan 16, 2027. Decisions by early March 2027.
how_to_apply: Attend an information session with a parent or guardian, then submit the application, two recommendation forms from non-family adults, and a video under 2 minutes about your favorite way to play.
notes: Not everyone is accepted. If selected, you take a virtual Volunteer 101 and in-person Mission 101 and Play 101 trainings. Teens 16 and up can also volunteer on their own without Teen Play Corps. Questions: teenplaycorps@marbleskidsmuseum.org.
